title: Cascade Ortho Rider Certificate — Lifetime Orthodontic Maximum
content:
**Lifetime orthodontic maximum under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders.**

The lifetime orthodontic maximum applies per person. It counts every orthodontic payment Cascade has made for that person under any rider, including riders that have since terminated. The amount used is the person's initial and installment payments less reversals, across every Cascade orthodontic rider the person has held, a person being identified by the same enrollee name and date of birth. Payments made by other carriers do not count.

The maximum that applies is the lifetime orthodontic maximum of the rider in force on the payment date. When a person moves to a rider with a higher maximum, the earlier payments still count against the new maximum.

No payment may take the person's lifetime orthodontic payments above the applicable maximum:

- the payment that reaches the maximum is reduced to the remaining amount;
- later installments are not paid;
- the case is closed with the reason "lifetime maximum reached".

A reversal restores the reversed amount to the remaining lifetime maximum.

## The remaining lifetime maximum

The remaining lifetime maximum is the applicable maximum less the person's lifetime orthodontic payments, and never less than zero. A payment is limited to the lesser of its amount and that remaining figure.

| Hypothetical position | Payment due | Payment made |
|---|---|---|
| maximum 1,500.00, used 1,380.00 (remaining 120.00) | 150.00 | 120.00, after which the case is closed as lifetime maximum reached |
| maximum 1,500.00, used 1,380.00, then a 60.00 reversal (remaining 180.00) | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| maximum 2,000.00 on a new rider, 1,100.00 paid under an earlier rider (remaining 900.00) | 150.00 | 150.00 |
